spanish: Todo varón y mujer que impulsó su corazón a ellos a traer a toda la obra que mandó Jehová a hacer en mano de Moisés, trajeron hijos de Israel ofrenda voluntaria a Jehová.

findings.issue: Qal 3ms has the heart as subject and אתם as its direct object. 'que impulsó su corazón a ellos' makes the man and woman the subject who impel the heart toward another party.

notes: The other tokens match, including both bring-verbs, the work Jehová commanded to do by the hand of Moses, and the sons of Israel bringing a freewill offering to Jehová.
